Name: Hotter Demetrius
Author: holychurros
Description:
I felt like Demetrius was done SO DIRTY. I like him well enough, so lets let him get at least a decent haircut? I went for the relaxed hair and the clear part, and I fixed his nose.

Compatibility:

This is just a Demetrius visual replacement. There should be compatibility with any SVE or any other neighborhood extenders. If you're looking for a seasonal addition, I'm not as great yet with that. I hope to be able to add that in the future!

How to use:

This is just a classic Content Patcher. Download, unzip, and drop it in your Mods folder with Content Patcher! As long as there aren't any other visual Haley mods, you should be good to go!

If someone wants to use this as a base for a seasonal, message me!
